evidence.quote: currently only accesses the European Union data center
processed on our infrastructure in the EEA

hosting_regions.note: API docs list the EU endpoint as the default; US and Japan regional endpoints exist only for customers who sign a regional deployment addendum. evidence.quote: The transmission of this content is necessary in order for us to provide the translation or improvement

local_first.note: Translation runs on DeepL's servers. The mobile apps keep saved translations on the device, but translation itself is server-side.

evidence.quote: currently only accesses the European Union data center

eu_residency.note: The web app uses only the EU data centre and the standard API endpoint is the EU one; US/JP processing needs a signed addendum. Caveat: Pro terms 3.1.3 reserve DeepL's right to determine the processing location, including third-party cloud infrastructure. The DPA (which sets processing locations) was not readable: source blocked: https://deepl.safebase.us/item/data-processing-agreement

evidence.quote: DeepL may process Content, Processed Content and Customer Training Data on its servers as well as on technical infrastructure
Amazon Web Services EMEA SARL

cloud_providers.note: Microsoft and AWS are named only for hosting the Voice for Meetings bot. The terms name no other third-party cloud providers. Cloudflare (CDN) not counted.

transfer_mechanism.note: The privacy policy names no DPF certification or SCCs for customer content (only an adequacy decision for the Bettermode community platform). source blocked: https://trust.deepl.com/ and source blocked: https://support.deepl.com/hc/en-us/articles/26380849099932-DeepL-infrastructure-and-data-protection

subprocessors_public.note: The DORA page says sub-processors are listed in Annex 1 of the DPA, which sits in the trust centre. source blocked: https://deepl.safebase.us/item/data-processing-agreement (deepl.com/en/subprocessors returns 404)

evidence.quote: Changes will be communicated to you in advance with reasonable notice (2 weeks), giving you the opportunity to object.

subprocessor_notice.note: Stated on DeepL's DORA addendum page, summarising the DPA. The DPA itself was not readable.

evidence.quote: available for download in the DeepL Trust Centre

dpa.note: Terms say the DPA is downloadable from the trust centre and forms part of the Pro agreement. The DPA itself was not read: source blocked: https://deepl.safebase.us/item/data-processing-agreement. Privacy policy also says to contact privacy@deepl.com for an Art. 28 agreement.

evidence.quote: we act in our capacity as processor
acts as controller of, and is responsible for processing your personal data

role.note: Processor for customer content under the DPA; controller for website, account and marketing data, and for content in the free version.

privacy_policy_date.note: Privacy policy says 'Last update: October 2026' with no day, so a YYYY-MM-DD date cannot be set.

evidence.quote: DeepL will only temporarily store Content or Processed Content to the extent technically required to provide its Services

retention_stated.note: Content saved at the customer's request (saved translations, glossaries) is kept until deleted or the agreement ends. Voice transcripts: admin-set retention from 20 seconds to 30 days.

evidence.quote: this will be deleted 90 days after the end of the Agreement

deletion_on_exit.note: Applies to content saved at the customer's request. Other data is covered by the DPA, which was not readable.

evidence.quote: Retrieve the term pairs stored in a v3 multilingual glossary dictionary, returned in TSV format.

data_export.note: Glossaries (TSV) and translation memories can be read back through the API. Terms 3.1.5 say Customer Training Data 'cannot be returned to the Customer'. No general export of saved translations found.

breach_notice.note: No breach notification window in the privacy policy, Pro terms or DORA page. The DPA, where it would normally be, was not readable: source blocked: https://deepl.safebase.us/item/data-processing-agreement

evidence.quote: shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the law of England and Wales

governing_law.note: Pro terms, clause 17. Exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of England and Wales; mandatory consumer law of the consumer's country unaffected.

evidence.quote: specialises in services based on machine learning, e.g., machine translation services
The third party data processing may utilise DeepL's proprietary models
we use backup voices provided by our subprocessor ElevenLabs

ai_providers.note: ElevenLabs is used only for backup voices in the Voice product, for languages without a DeepL voice.

evidence.quote: it's never used to train DeepL's AI models
your texts will not be used to improve the quality of our services
We process the content you upload and their translations or improvements for a limited period of time to train and improve our neural networks

trains_on_content.note: Institutional (Pro/API Pro) answer: no training. The data-security page words it as 'never stored or used for model training without your consent'.
trains_on_content.footnote: The free version is different: the privacy policy says free-service texts and corrections are used to train DeepL's neural networks, and the terms forbid entering personal data there.

ai_zero_retention.note: DeepL runs its own models and says Pro content is stored only temporarily and deleted after processing, but no zero-retention statement for the third-party voice provider (ElevenLabs) was found.

ai_admin_off.note: No admin setting to disable AI features found on the Pro, Enterprise, data-security or developer pages; AI is the product itself.

evidence.quote: The Services are not intended for high-risk use as set out in Article 6 of the EU AI Act
